idea: One rainy November late afternoon in the back-door mudroom of a 1908 Portland Sellwood farmhouse, shot from one locked frame, cycling through 9 bench-and-storage wall layouts from a single oak peg rail over a floating bench to three lit Douglas fir lockers with ink-blue backs.
